name: Y2K Coquette Giant Teddy Bear
image_vibe: nostalgic pink comfort, playful Y2K glamour
image_purpose: social fashion campaign and editorial moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic Y2K fashion portrait centered on a giant black teddy bear and soft pink studio styling.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with voluminous 90s blowout and curtain bangs, dreamy expression, glossy pink lips, dewy flushed cheeks, white long-sleeve top, matching high-waisted opaque white leggings, and a simple non-branded black satin mule; she sits beside and gently embraces the oversized teddy bear rather than straddling it.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level close-up to medium portrait in a seamless pastel-pink studio, giant black teddy bear as central prop, subject and plush texture sharply detailed, soft monochromatic palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-key diffused studio lighting, bright commercial fashion finish, minimal harsh shadows, gentle nostalgic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens at f/4, RAW photorealism, 8K texture, realistic hair, skin, jersey fabric, satin, and plush, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic Y2K coquette fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with voluminous 90s blowout and curtain bangs, dreamy expression, glossy pink lips, dewy flushed cheeks, white long-sleeve top, high-waisted opaque white leggings, simple non-branded black satin mule, seated beside and gently embracing a massive plush black teddy bear, pastel pink seamless studio, high-key diffused lighting, 50mm f/4, realistic plush and skin texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed midriff, sexualized straddling, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, designer logo, watermark, text, plastic skin, airbrushed, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: Y2K teddy bear reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the pink studio, 90s hair, white outfit, giant black plush, gentle embrace, and soft light; keep identity and accessories replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the nostalgic coquette mood while using opaque coverage, a nonsexual side embrace, and a clearly adult fictional identity.

changes: Removed public-figure resemblance, added opaque high-waisted coverage, replaced straddling with a gentle side embrace, and removed designer logo.
